entities.name: NR5A1
observations: Also called SF-1; implicated in 46,XX testicular/ovotesticular DSD by specific variants, including p.Arg92Trp.

entities.name: 46,XX testicular/ovotesticular DSD
observations: Includes testicular or combined testicular-ovarian gonadal tissue in individuals with a 46,XX karyotype.

entities.name: PMID:27610946
observations: Reported identical NR5A1 p.Arg92Trp variants in two unrelated Japanese 46,XX individuals with testicular/ovotesticular DSD; in vitro mutant protein was less sensitive to NR0B1 suppression at the SOX9 enhancer.

entities.name: PMID:36657429
observations: Systematic review found pathogenic NR5A1 variants in 3 of 56 investigated 46,XX ovotesticular DSD cases (5%), indicating a real but infrequent cause.

entities.name: PMID:30350900
observations: In a cohort of 26 patients, identified p.Arg92Trp in three unrelated individuals and a further NR5A1 variant; functional assays implicated repression of ovarian WNT signaling and reduced NR0B1 upregulation.
